content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Github pages

GitHub Pages is a static site hosting service that allows creators to host their digital product stores for free. This means that creators can sell their ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, and other digital products without incurring the costs associated with traditional hosting services. Moreover, GitHub Pages integrates seamlessly with other tools like Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, enabling creators to build a fully functional and sovereign digital commerce stack.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a GitHub Pages-hosted digital product store relies on a combination of free and paid tools. For example, Cloudflare Workers can be used to handle backend logic, while NOWPayments provides automatic crypto payment verification. This setup enables creators to receive payments in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and USDT, which can then be converted to fiat currencies. The result is a highly scalable and secure digital commerce stack that can handle a high volume of transactions.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically designed for digital creators who are restricted from using traditional payment platforms like Stripe and PayPal. In many countries, these platforms are either unavailable or severely limited, leaving creators without a reliable means to collect payments. By leveraging GitHub Pages and other free and paid tools, creators can build a sovereign digital commerce stack that is not dependent on any single platform or payment gateway.
GitHub Pages offers free hosting for digital product stores, eliminating the need for traditional hosting services.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make up this digital commerce stack include GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic crypto payment verification. Each of these components plays a critical role in enabling creators to sell their digital products securely and efficiently. By integrating these components, creators can build a highly scalable and secure digital commerce stack that can handle a high volume of transactions.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a GitHub Pages-hosted digital product store today, creators can start by setting up a GitHub Pages site and integrating it with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. They can then add their digital products to the site and configure the payment gateway to receive payments in cryptocurrencies. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), creators can get instant access to all the blueprints and templates they need to build, deploy, and scale their digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can use a combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. This setup enables creators to receive payments in cryptocurrencies, which can then be converted to fiat currencies. For example, NOWPayments charges only 0.5% per transaction, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee, which can result in significant savings for creators.

To deploy a GitHub Pages-hosted digital product store, creators can follow these steps: set up a GitHub Pages site, integrate it with Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments, add digital products to the site, configure the payment gateway to receive payments in cryptocurrencies, and test the site to ensure that it is working correctly.
